purpose: Machine-readable vocabulary for the website filters. Any value the detector cannot yet produce is marked detectable:false so the UI does not offer a filter that can never match, and any value that is inherently not machine-detectable is marked needs_human:true.

discrepancy_types.label: Goal -> no goal
discrepancy_types.description: A goal that appeared in the official record was later removed.

discrepancy_types.label: No goal -> goal
discrepancy_types.description: A goal absent from the official record was later added.

discrepancy_types.label: Strength change
discrepancy_types.description: EV/PP/SH classification of a goal changed.

discrepancy_types.label: Own-goal annotation change
discrepancy_types.description: The own-goal annotation of a goal changed.

discrepancy_types.label: Goal time changed
discrepancy_types.description: The recorded clock of an existing goal moved (the goal count and the scorer are unchanged).

discrepancy_types.label: Goal reassigned to the other team
discrepancy_types.description: Own-goal re-attribution: team totals, the puck line and the winner can change even though the game total cannot.

discrepancy_types.label: Multiple changes on one goal
discrepancy_types.description: More than one category of change on the same goal.

discrepancy_types.label: Non-scoring metadata change
discrepancy_types.description: Score or state changed without a matching goal-set change (inconsistent feed). Always flagged for review.

discrepancy_types.label: No change detected
discrepancy_types.description: Control value; used in state comparisons, never stored as a discrepancy record.

timing.label: After the final horn, before the record was published as final
After the record was published as final

settlement_levels.label: Critical - goal total changed after publication
Medium - goal total changed while live
Attribution only - cannot move a game total

evidence_statuses.label: Verified: both states from official artifacts
Verified corrected state + league's own announcement
evidence_statuses.note: The corrected state is verified from an official report or game feed AND the league's own announcement states that the change was made. What the record read BEFORE the change may still be missing - each record's flags say exactly which part.

reason_categories.label: Stated verbatim inside an official artifact
Not stated in any retrieved official artifact

not_detectable_automatically: Why a change happened (video review, statistician correction, post-game review) unless an official artifact states it in words.
Any change that occurred entirely between two of our own polls of a source that we did not capture, when no archive snapshot exists from before the change.
Changes to sportsbook settlement behaviour, which is governed by private house rules.
Discrepancies in leagues, competitions or feeds that are not published by the NHL's own endpoints.

cause_filters.label: video review (only when an official source says so)
cause_filters.how: Matches records whose reason.text is a verbatim official quote mentioning review. No machine-readable review feed exists, so this filter can only match what an official artifact states in words.

cause_filters.label: reason not stated in any retrieved official artifact

not_offered_and_why.video_review_flag_from_the_feed: Not offered as a feed-derived flag: no review event type exists in the observed official event vocabulary (data/schema/observed_vocabulary.json). Offered only as 'cause stated officially'.

provenance_paths.auto_poll: monitor/collect: poll an official feed, diff two captures of the same URL. Strongest evidence (two official states, timestamps for each) but blind to anything that happened before polling started.
provenance_paths.official_statement_ingest: ingest: the league's own announcement, cross-checked against the corrected state in an official report. Covers corrections that happened before monitoring existed. The pre-change state is only asserted when a source asserts it, never reconstructed.
provenance_paths.archived_two_snapshot_diff: archive/backfill-archive: two archived captures of the same official document with different content digests. Not yet exercised end to end - see docs/ROADMAP.md.

record_statuses.label: Built from the league's own announcement
record_statuses.note: Every field is traceable to a stored URL; flags name anything that is missing.
